title: How Halden keeps monitored data inside your environment

sections.heading: The question
sections.body_markdown: Security teams ask where monitored data goes. [E6]

sections.heading: The answer
sections.body_markdown: The Halden agent runs inside your own cloud account, so row-level data does not leave it. [E4] Connectors use read-only credentials. [E5]

sections.heading: What is monitored
sections.body_markdown: Halden checks for schema drift, freshness failures and volume anomalies and alerts the owning team within five minutes. [E1]
